title: All 1400 tick hashes replaced with no justification visible in the diff; wholesale re-bless can launder a behavior regression
detail: Every expected value diverges from tick 1 onward while seed, logic_hz, ticks, and format version stay identical. Nothing in the file or chunk distinguishes an intended serialization/catalog change from an unintended simulation change.
recommended_fix: Document the deterministic cause of the re-bless (commit message or golden manifest), and confirm semantics-unchanged by regenerating with a second seed or independently verifying tick 1.

title: Entire hash stream changed but format version 't1 1' and header carry no hash-scheme/generator version field
detail: Old and new files share the same format version yet share zero hash values; the header records catalog_hash but no hash-algorithm or tool version, making algorithm drift untraceable from the artifact itself.
recommended_fix: Add a hash-scheme or generator-version field to the .t1 header, or bump the t1 format version whenever hash derivation changes.
